wake-up.definition: To stop sleeping and become awake.
wake-up.exampleUsage: I wake up early every morning before dawn.

get-up.definition: To rise and leave your bed after sleeping.
get-up.exampleUsage: He gets up right after the alarm rings.

yawn.definition: To open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply when tired or sleepy.
yawn.exampleUsage: She began to yawn after a long day at work.

stretch.definition: To extend your arms, legs, or body to full length to loosen your muscles.
stretch.exampleUsage: He likes to stretch his arms after waking up.

shower.definition: To wash your body while standing under a spray of water.
shower.exampleUsage: I shower with warm water before getting dressed.

brush-teeth.definition: To clean your teeth using a toothbrush and toothpaste.
brush-teeth.exampleUsage: Yusuf brushes his teeth before breakfast.

get-dressed.definition: To put on your clothes for the day.
get-dressed.exampleUsage: Yusuf gets dressed before leaving for work.

eat-breakfast.definition: To have the first meal of the day in the morning.
eat-breakfast.exampleUsage: We sit together as a family to eat breakfast.

pack-lunch.definition: To prepare midday food and put it into a container or bag to take with you.
pack-lunch.exampleUsage: I pack lunch at night so it is ready for work.

leave-home.definition: To go out of your house to travel to work, school, or another place.
leave-home.exampleUsage: They leave home at seven o'clock every morning.

eat.definition: To put food into your mouth, chew it, and swallow it.
eat.exampleUsage: We eat fresh fruit and vegetables every day.

drink.definition: To take water or another liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
drink.exampleUsage: Yusuf drinks water with his lunch.

chew.definition: To crush and grind food with your teeth before swallowing it.
chew.exampleUsage: Yusuf chews the bread before swallowing it.

swallow.definition: To make food or drink pass from your mouth down your throat.
swallow.exampleUsage: Sam chews the bread before he swallows it.

sip.definition: To drink a liquid slowly by taking very small amounts at a time.
sip.exampleUsage: He sat by the window to sip his hot mint tea.

gulp.definition: To swallow food or drink quickly in large amounts.
gulp.exampleUsage: Sam gulps water quickly from a glass.

bite.definition: To use your teeth to cut into or break off a piece of food.
bite.exampleUsage: Sam bites a piece of bread.

taste.definition: To try a small amount of food or drink to check its flavor.
taste.exampleUsage: Please taste the soup to see if it needs more salt.

lick.definition: To move your tongue across the surface of something.
lick.exampleUsage: Sam licks his own dessert spoon.

slurp.definition: To eat or drink a liquid with a loud sucking sound.
slurp.exampleUsage: Try not to slurp your soup at the dinner table.

cook.definition: To prepare food for eating by heating it on a stove or in an oven.
cook.exampleUsage: My father loves to cook rice and grilled chicken on Fridays.

clean.definition: To remove dirt, dust, or mess from a room or surface.
clean.exampleUsage: We clean the kitchen counter after preparing dinner.

wash.definition: To clean something using water and soap.
wash.exampleUsage: Maya washes the bowls after lunch.

sweep.definition: To clear dust and crumbs from the floor using a broom.
sweep.exampleUsage: I sweep the hallway floor every afternoon.

vacuum.definition: To clean carpets and floors using a vacuum cleaner.
vacuum.exampleUsage: He will vacuum the living room rug before the guests arrive.

iron.definition: To press clothes with a heated iron to remove wrinkles.
iron.exampleUsage: I need to iron my shirt before the morning meeting.

fold.definition: To bend cloth or paper neatly so one part lies over another.
fold.exampleUsage: Please fold the clean towels and put them on the shelf.

organize.definition: To arrange items neatly and in a clear, useful order.
organize.exampleUsage: She took an hour to organize the books on her desk.

repair.definition: To fix something that is broken or damaged so it works again.
repair.exampleUsage: The carpenter came to repair the broken wooden chair.

decorate.definition: To make a room or object look more attractive by adding nice details.
decorate.exampleUsage: We decorate the living room with lanterns before Ramadan.

bathe.definition: To wash your body in a bathtub or with water.

shave.definition: To trim or remove hair from the face or skin with a razor.
shave.exampleUsage: He uses warm water and foam when he wants to shave.

comb.definition: To make hair neat and untangled using a comb.
comb.exampleUsage: I comb my hair neatly in front of the mirror.

style.definition: To arrange hair in a neat or particular way.
style.exampleUsage: He takes a few minutes to style his hair before going out.

apply.definition: To put a substance onto a surface; here lotion onto the skin.
apply.exampleUsage: Omar applies lotion to his hands.

moisturize.definition: To put cream or oil on the skin to keep it soft and prevent dryness.
moisturize.exampleUsage: Omar uses lotion to moisturize his hands.

trim.definition: To keep hair, a beard, or nails neat by cutting away a small amount.
trim.exampleUsage: The barber used scissors to trim his beard neatly.

floss.definition: To clean between the teeth using a thin piece of dental thread.
floss.exampleUsage: Omar uses dental thread to floss his teeth.

gargle.definition: To hold liquid in the back of the mouth and move it with air from the throat.
gargle.exampleUsage: The product instructions say whether to gargle with the liquid.

dry-off.definition: To wipe water from your skin or hair using a clean towel.
dry-off.exampleUsage: Use a soft cotton towel to dry off after washing.

rest.definition: To stop working or moving in order to relax and recover strength.
rest.exampleUsage: Sit down and rest for a few minutes after carrying the boxes.

relax.definition: To become calm and less tense while resting comfortably.
relax.exampleUsage: Reading a quiet book in the evening helps me relax.

nap.definition: To sleep for a short period of time, especially during the day.
nap.exampleUsage: He likes to nap for twenty minutes after midday prayer.

sleep.definition: To be in the natural resting state in which you are not awake.
sleep.exampleUsage: Omar sleeps in his bedroom at night.

dream.definition: To experience thoughts, images, or stories in your mind while sleeping.
dream.exampleUsage: Omar sometimes dreams about a holiday.

snore.definition: To breathe with a rough, noisy sound while sleeping.
snore.exampleUsage: Omar’s brother sometimes snores while asleep.

doze.definition: To sleep lightly for a short time, often without meaning to.
doze.exampleUsage: The passenger began to doze during the quiet train ride.

meditate.definition: To practise focused attention or quiet reflection, often while sitting still.
meditate.exampleUsage: He sits quietly in the morning to reflect and meditate.

unwind.definition: To let go of stress and relax after a busy day of work.
unwind.exampleUsage: A quiet walk in the park helps me unwind after work.

recharge.definition: To regain your energy and strength by resting.
recharge.exampleUsage: A peaceful weekend with family helps me recharge for the week.
